scripts.dev:electron: NODE_ENV=development tsx scripts/build-electron.ts && fuser -k 3000/tcp 2>/dev/null; NODE_ENV=development NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx/cjs' electron . --no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage
